Tiszakanyar Jewish Cemetery Two

Jewish Cemetery · Fő utca 1, Hungary

Not demolished. This record shows a tension worth noting: it is categorized as 'demolished, not built over,' yet the source's demolished field marks it as 'no.' There were two Jewish cemeteries in Tiszakanyár; this one was established as early as 1870, per that year's cadastral map. The Jewish population, never large, peaked at 28 in 1870; three families named Klein were taken to the Kisvárda Ghetto on April 16, 1944, when carts carrying the Jews of Dombrád passed through the village, and deported to Auschwitz that May. By 1949, no Jews remained in Tiszakanyár. A hill once marking the cemetery site has since disappeared, and the current landowner had never heard of the cemetery's existence.
